definitions.daily_returns: Every calendar day in the frozen split is retained; days without a position have zero strategy return
definitions.historical_spread_proxy: Median Corwin-Schultz estimate from 15m OHLC bars; not observed bid/ask
definitions.median_spread: Median top-of-book quoted spread across repeated live ticker snapshots
definitions.median_turnover: Median platformTurnover24h across repeated live ticker snapshots
definitions.session: 16:15 ET after the previous NYSE session through 09:00 ET of the target NYSE session
definitions.usable_session: >=80% 15m-bar coverage, nonzero aggregate volume, and historical spread proxy <= 20.0 bps; weeknights additionally require rQQQ or rSPY, weekend/holiday nights require BTC and ETH
definitions.zero_volume_fraction: Fraction of post-launch completed overnight sessions with aggregate API candle volume equal to zero

recommendation.reason: The add tier supplies only 0 unique strategy days; it does not improve calendar coverage and adds execution/model-selection complexity.
